title: Cinnamon Rice Pud
description: A comforting rice pudding made with semi-skimmed milk, pudding rice and cinnamon cereal — the cereal flavours the milk and adds a crunchy topping.

ingredients.text: 160g cinnamon cereal (e.g. Golden Grahams or Curiously Cinnamon)

steps: Grease a deep pudding dish (at least 2 litres) with butter.
Heat the milk gently in a saucepan until just bubbling.
Measure out the rice and crush 140g of the cereal in a bag with a rolling pin (keep some texture).
Take the milk off the heat, add the rice and cereal, stir and leave to infuse for a couple of minutes.
Pour into the dish and bake uncovered for 1 hour 20 minutes until golden skin on top and bubbling at the edges.
Serve straight from the dish, topped with the remaining 20g cereal crumbled over.
notes: Serves 6. Keep extra hot milk on hand to stir in if you prefer it runnier.
